changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Split conflated Not Done/Positive/Negative testedSyphilis values on pmtct_mother_visitation into the Yes/No + testResultSyphilis scheme
changeSet.sql: UPDATE pmtct_mother_visitation SET syphilis_info = syphilis_info || jsonb_build_object( 'testedSyphilis', CASE WHEN syphilis_info->>'testedSyphilis' = 'Not Done' THEN 'No' ELSE 'Yes' END, 'testResultSyphilis', CASE WHEN syphilis_info->>'testedSyphilis' = 'Not Done' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(syphilis_info->>'testResultSyphilis', ''), '') ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(syphilis_info->>'testResultSyphilis', ''), syphilis_info->>'testedSyphilis') END ) WHERE syphilis_info ?? 'testedSyphilis' AND syphilis_info->>'testedSyphilis' IN ('Not Done', 'Positive', 'Negative');

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Backfill pmtct_anc.syphilis_info from the latest ANC Revisit that documented a real tested value, only where the ANC record itself has none
changeSet.sql: UPDATE pmtct_anc anc SET syphilis_info = mv.syphilis_info FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (patient_uuid, pmtct_cycle_uuid) patient_uuid, pmtct_cycle_uuid, syphilis_info FROM pmtct_mother_visitation WHERE visit_type = 'ANC_REVISIT' AND archived = false AND syphilis_info->>'testedSyphilis' = 'Yes' ORDER BY patient_uuid, pmtct_cycle_uuid, date_of_visit DESC, id DESC ) mv WHERE anc.patient_uuid = mv.patient_uuid AND anc.pmtct_cycle_uuid = mv.pmtct_cycle_uuid AND COALESCE(anc.syphilis_info->>'testedSyphilis', '') = '';

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Backfill pmtct_anc.hepatitis_b_info from the latest ANC Revisit that documented a real tested value, only where the ANC record itself has none
changeSet.sql: UPDATE pmtct_anc anc SET hepatitis_b_info = mv.hepatitis_b_info FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (patient_uuid, pmtct_cycle_uuid) patient_uuid, pmtct_cycle_uuid, hepatitis_b_info FROM pmtct_mother_visitation WHERE visit_type = 'ANC_REVISIT' AND archived = false AND COALESCE(hepatitis_b_info->>'testedHepatitisB', '') != '' ORDER BY patient_uuid, pmtct_cycle_uuid, date_of_visit DESC, id DESC ) mv WHERE anc.patient_uuid = mv.patient_uuid AND anc.pmtct_cycle_uuid = mv.pmtct_cycle_uuid AND COALESCE(anc.hepatitis_b_info->>'testedHepatitisB', '') = '';
